name: QA send later
description: QA only (graph-integrity G6): while its setting is on, the user's send in a chat is stopped quietly (the composer cleared once the message is kept), kept in this mod's storage, shown above that chat's composer, and sent by a scheduled job a minute later as this mod, with its key (looked up first after an uncertain delivery), across a relaunch. While `answerLater` is on, a pending approval is answered by this mod eleven minutes on (past any old ceiling), unless the user answered it first; while `stopAgent` is on, a turn the agent starts by itself is stopped as it starts.
